case.question: 2024年线上销量最高的三个品类是什么？
case.gold_sql: SELECT p.category AS 品类,SUM(i.quantity) AS 销量 FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND o.channel='线上' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 销量 DESC LIMIT 3

before.sql: SELECT p.category AS 品类, o.channel AS 渠道, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id=p.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY p.category, o.channel ORDER BY 销量 DESC LIMIT 3

after.sql: SELECT p.category AS 品类, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id=p.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.channel IN ('线上') AND strftime('%Y',o.order_date) IN ('2024') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 销量 DESC LIMIT 3

case.question: 2024年12月相比11月线上销售额环比
case.gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date) AS m,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS s FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.channel='线上' GROUP BY m) SELECT ROUND(100.0*((SELECT s FROM m WHERE m='2024-12')-(SELECT s FROM m WHERE m='2024-11'))/(SELECT s FROM m WHERE m='2024-11'),1) AS 环比增长率

before.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date) AS 月份, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) AS 销售额 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 月份) SELECT ROUND(100.0*((SELECT 销售额 FROM m WHERE 月份='2024-12')-(SELECT 销售额 FROM m WHERE 月份='2024-11'))/(SELECT 销售额 FROM m WHERE 月份='2024-11'),1) AS 环比增长率

after.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date) AS 月份, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) AS 销售额 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.channel IN ('线上') AND strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date) IN ('2024-11','2024-12') GROUP BY 月份) SELECT ROUND(100.0*((SELECT 销售额 FROM m WHERE 月份='2024-12')-(SELECT 销售额 FROM m WHERE 月份='2024-11'))/NULLIF((SELECT 销售额 FROM m WHERE 月份='2024-11'),0),1) AS 环比增长率
